svg.title: Double-crossover meiosis
svg.desc: The same two nonsister chromatids cross at two sites, swapping middle segments that contain the centromeres. R and B label the red and blue centromeres. Homologs separate by centromere in meiosis I. Meiosis II separates sisters, yielding solid red and blue parental chromatids and reciprocal blue-red-blue and red-blue-red recombinants.
